memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: And God said, "Let the water teem with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth across the vault of the sky." - Gen 1:20 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
On the fifth day, God's creation bursts into motion. Until now, the earth has been shaped and filled with light and plants, but here, for the first time, God brings forth living, moving creatures. He commands the waters to teem with life and the skies to be filled with birds. Suddenly the world is alive, swimming, darting, soaring.

What a generous, joyful God we have. He does not make just a few creatures; He makes the waters "teem." The oceans overflow with fish of every shape and colour; the skies fill with birds of endless variety. God delights in abundance, in fullness, in life spilling over. Creation is not bare and minimal; it is rich and overflowing, a picture of His generous heart.

This same God has not changed. He is still a God of abundant life. Jesus said He came that we might have life, and have it to the full (Jn 10:10). The fullness God poured into the seas and skies points us to the fuller life He offers our souls in Christ.

When life feels dull or empty, remember the God who fills oceans and skies with teeming life. He is able to bring freshness, movement, and joy into your walk with Him. Look around at the birds and the waters, and let their abundance remind you of how generous your Maker truly is.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Where do you long for God to bring fresh life and abundance in your walk with Him?
2. How does the fullness of creation reflect the generous heart of God to you?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, You fill the seas and skies with teeming, abundant life. Thank You for the full life You offer in Christ. Refresh my soul with Your life today. Amen.
